_description: Genuine agentic retrieval: a LangGraph agent drives a real MCP server's four-tool catalog and formulates its own Milvus queries, governed by Caber at the LangChain BaseTool boundary. Object permits via filename-to-user group paths; authentication via streamlit-authenticator under the agentic-chat-app issuer; users, groups, roles and tenant from the mock-idp SCIM directory (MIMU).
_sdk_seed_api_key_note: GLOBAL.sdk.seedApiKey is the first SDK API key caber-core imports at boot (format csi_dream_<uuid4>.<secret>; env override CSI_GLOBAL_SDK_SEED_API_KEY). The CSI_API_KEY default in this demo's docker-compose.yaml is this same value, so every SDK instance registers under the seed key's key_id. GLOBAL.sdk.requireApiKey is false in every demo: it turns off both the Dashboard's /v1 key gate and caber-core's /v1/sdk and /v1/auth gate, so the console and hand-run tools work without a key; a key that is sent and verifies still attributes SDK registrations. With it true, caber-core refuses every SDK call without a valid key. To rotate, change both together, or export CSI_API_KEY and CSI_GLOBAL_SDK_SEED_API_KEY to one new value before launching. DEMO-ONLY VALUE: the key is committed so the demo starts without setup; it must never be reused outside a demo.
_sdk_operator_enforce_mode_note: GLOBAL.sdk.operatorEnforceMode (read once at caber-core boot, default false) enables PUT /v1/sdk/instances/{id}/enforce_mode: the e2e mode switches (runner/core/runtime_enforce_mode.py) move the chat app and MCP server between enforce and observe through their next heartbeat instead of a container recreate. Only an SDK that reports the operator_enforce_mode capability applies a request; with an older wheel the switches fall back to the recreate. The boot mode is still CSI_GLOBAL_REDACT_ENABLED; demo.py up leaves the chat app in observe.
_forked_from: demos/agentgov-mimic/config.json -- agentgov-mimic is kept FROZEN (ticket 05). This is a fork of its overlay, not a modification of it. Differences from mimic are listed in the notes below and each one is a recorded decision, not drift.
_agent_host_note: The bare selfAC ApiMap entry is LOAD-BEARING, not tuning. pycaber.auto posts in-process agent actions (tool calls, retriever queries, graph invocations) under api_host = the container hostname (agentic-chat-app, from HOSTNAME) with api_scheme framework and no framework suffix (PyCaber pycaber/auto/_agent_actions.py _api_host). load_api_map expands a self key with no port or selector into the aliases localhost, 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0 and the container hostname, so selfAC is the entry that matches; selfAC:langchain and selfAC:* only match a host carrying a :<framework> selector. Without a matching entry, get_host_config falls through to `default`, whose function is `log`, which HostConfig::is_drop() treats as a drop: preprocess_content returns an EMPTY body, nothing is fingerprinted, no OBO decision exists, and no redaction can fire at all. `function: intercept` + `enableOBO: true` is the minimum; the entry needs no Unit override because agent actions take the Unit row's agent choice (CABER-ADJ-UNIT-001 params.agent, key_group over output and input). The chat app's filter token selfAC loads it. Spec: PyCaber/docs/systems/AGENT_HOST_APIMAP.md section 2.
_doc_parser_note: NER is off in the base stack: GLiNER2 ingest classification needs the host-run model server, which only the --with-ner overlay (docker-compose.ner.yaml, ner/config.json) provides. csi-init merges this block recursively over shared/config/config-base.json, where DocParser.gliner.enabled is true.
_ner_verdict_note: The LLM (gpt-4o) nerVerdict pass is DISABLED, as in mimic: region sensitivity tiers must come from the GLiNER2 ingest classifier writing sensitivity/entity properties onto :Data:Region / :Data:Fixed nodes with a :Sensitive label -- NOT from an LLM verdict.
_identity_sources_note: Identity follows the IdP-attributed governance spec (PyCaber docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-12-idp-attributed-governance-design.md). The api-type `mimic_users` source and the AuthDefaultMap are gone: users, groups, roles and tenant come from ONE place, the mock-idp SCIM directory (Identity_Sources.mock_idp_directory, identifier MIMU, seeded from identity/directory.json). agentic_chat_app declares the chat app's issuer; its emails are trusted because the app provisions its own logins. F2U (filenameToUser) writes an object's permits from its group path (`cats/x.md` -> `permits: [cats]`) and has no defaults or outmap. The amy-vs-bob policy contrast (ticket 09 mechanic 5) is now a group contrast: amy is in cats, bob is in dogs, so bob's directory groups do not meet the permits on cats/ documents. mock-idp must therefore run in this demo's topology to serve the directory.

policies.name: Sensitive delivery requires a grant
policies.description: Disabled in this demo. The entry stays only because PyCaber's policy-set validator requires every system policy to be present (missing_system_policy). The enabled guard, together with the HIPAA framework policy, is demonstrated by the hipaa-ner demo.

policies.name: Unit of enforcement
policies.description: How far a deny, stale or duplicate span spreads, and how a unit holding both flagged and clear bytes is settled.

policies.name: Stale data
policies.description: How stale data is withheld, ranked against fresh results, or returned with a notice.

policies.name: Duplicates
policies.description: Keeps one item of each group of duplicate result-list items and drops the rest.

policies.name: Stale missing information
policies.description: How Stale handles missing freshness status, unresolved sources, unknown items, unscored items, and chunks with no result list.

policies.name: Duplicates missing information
policies.description: How Duplicates handles short items, unscored group members, and members of unknown freshness.

policies.name: Fallback
policies.description: What a result list returns when it holds no authorized fresh item.

policies.name: File-to-user ownership
policies.description: Users listed in the f2u owner list receive an object's content; any other caller falls through to default_disposition
